say.OpenAPI-to-MCP: Open A P I to M C P

scenes.name: ROOM 412
lines: Try a hotel keycard. Room 412 opens. The linen closet stays locked. At noon the same card stops working.
试一张酒店房卡。它能开 412 室，开不了布草间。到了中午，同一张卡也开不了房门。
A capability handle works on that principle. An agent can ask for a specific action. The proxy checks the grant.
能力句柄遵循同样的原理。智能体请求一项具体操作，代理检查授权。

scenes.name: INSIDE THE PROXY
lines: The agent presents its handle. NyxID checks its scope and adds the key inside the encrypted proxy.
智能体出示句柄。NyxID 核验权限，在加密代理内附上密钥。
The key stays out of the agent’s context. A write that needs approval waits for a human.
密钥不会进入智能体上下文。需要审批的写入会等待人工确认。
You can revoke the grant. Once that change takes effect, the proxy refuses the next request.
授权可以吊销。吊销生效后，代理拒绝下一次请求。

scenes.name: PRODUCTION AND DEVELOPMENT
lines: On November 27, production had 55 built-in services, 42 live OpenAPI-to-MCP specs, and seven gateways.
11 月 27 日线上有 55 项内置服务、42 份 OpenAPI 转 MCP 规范和 7 个网关。
Production supports nine messaging channel types. Development version 0.79.0 expands to eleven.
生产版本支持 9 类消息渠道，开发版本 0.79.0 扩展到 11 类。
